nodes.label: fonts.css
nodes.summary: Imports the Geist and Geist Mono variable web fonts (weights 100–900) from Google Fonts for use across the Vite/React design app UI.

nodes.label: globals.css
nodes.summary: Empty global stylesheet placeholder reserved for app-wide CSS overrides in the design app; currently contains no rules.

nodes.label: index.css
nodes.summary: Stylesheet entry point that aggregates the design app's styles by @import-ing fonts.css, tailwind.css, and theme.css; loaded by the app's main bootstrap.

nodes.label: tailwind.css
nodes.summary: Sets up Tailwind CSS v4 via @import 'tailwindcss' with an explicit @source glob for js/ts/jsx/tsx files, plus the tw-animate-css animation utilities.

nodes.label: theme.css
nodes.summary: Defines the design system theme: light (:root) and dark (.dark) CSS custom-property palettes (bg, surface, border, text, brand/copper accents, status colors), maps them to Tailwind theme tokens via @theme inline, sets base body typography (Geist sans/mono), and provides .glass and .tabular-nums utility classes.
